proofBoundary: tool feature matrix only; build/report evidence is not runtime proof or release close approval

features.notes: Uses shared trtexec-like parser and TensorRtExecService.
GUI creates the same TensorRtExecOptions model as CLI.
External model runtime proof remains sample-runner owned; generic --loadInputs can collect bounded runtime output without promoting proof.
No runtime probing or package proof promotion.
min/opt/max shapes and aliases are normalized.
--shapes, --inputShapes, and --batch are documented in help/README/parity artifacts; batch remains report evidence and does not replace explicit binding proof.

--avgTiming is applied through TensorRtBuilderConfig across TRT8/10/11 and read back during real builds; --minTiming uses the TRT8 legacy compatibility setter and remains parse-only on TRT10/11. This is builder evidence, not runtime proof.
FP16/BF16/TF32 are represented; INT8, --calib, --fp8, and --best are parsed/reported, but calibration cache, capability checks, and model-specific precision proof remain blocked from promotion.

Compatible float engines apply --iterations, --warmUp, --duration, effective --streams/--infStreams, --idleTime, --avgRuns, --percentile, boolean --threads, --useSpinWait, --noDataTransfers, and --useCudaGraph using independent execution-context/binding/stream owners. CUDA graph capture has controlled direct-enqueue fallback. This does not promote model correctness or package-consumer proof.
Bounded runtime timing executes for compatible float engines; dumpProfile, separateProfileRun, exportProfile, and saveProfile remain report artifacts unless model-specific evidence validates them.

--useSpinWait polls CUDA event readiness and --idleTime is applied between measured rounds; --sleepTime device-side launch-to-compute delay remains parse-report-only and is not replaced with CPU sleep.

--loadEngine performs readonly readback, then binds every float input in engine order and captures every float output when all runtime shapes are concrete. Capture without reference validation remains runtime-output-captured-unverified.

--dumpOutput, --dumpRawBindingsToFile, and --exportOutput request generic bounded runtime; without --loadInputs they use deterministic generated float input. Successful readback feeds every float output into logs, JSON, and deterministic engine-order raw bytes plus an offset/hash manifest. Capture without a reference match keeps OutputValidated, HasTensorOutputProof, and HasRawBindingProof false.

--referenceOutputs maps every engine output to a schemaVersion=1 JSON reference. Name, shape, count, absolute/relative tolerance, NaN policy, Infinity policy, source classification, file SHA256, and per-tensor diagnostics are copied into artifacts. Every output must pass; synthetic references remain synthetic runtime evidence.

dumpLayerInfo/exportLayerInfo now consume copied TensorRtEngineInspector layer text during real build/load-engine paths; dry-run or unavailable dependencies remain parse/report-only, and the copied diagnostic is not runtime proof. dumpProfile and separateProfileRun remain intent/report evidence.
--report is accepted as a compatibility alias and normalized to --exportReport; reports remain build/report evidence, not runtime proof.

features.feature: FP8, best, refit dump, and debug tensor diagnostics
features.notes: --fp8, --best, --dumpRefit, --markDebug, and --dumpDebugTensors remain parse/report-only until versioned precision capability and model-specific debug/refit output evidence exist.

features.feature: Engine packaging, ONNX refit, and weight streaming
features.notes: Version-compatible, lean-runtime exclusion and refit flags use typed set/readback. TRT10/11 --refitFromOnnx performs stripped-plan deserialize, copied inventory, parser load, engine commit, zero-error/missing gate, and only then context creation; weight-streaming budgets are also applied before context creation. TRT8 stays parse-only.

features.feature: Refitted plan persistence and independent reload
features.notes: The --saveRefittedEngine extension clears and reads back serialization ExcludeWeights, writes a path distinct from the stripped plan and ONNX source, disposes the committed engine, reloads a new engine from persisted full-weight bytes, checks copied metadata, and routes optional runtime through that reload. A separate local-feed PackageReference consumer now reproduces the output hash; neither path is public-feed, post-publish, or release proof.
--plugins, --plugin, --dynamicPlugins, and --setPluginsToSerialize normalize to plugin path diagnostics only; no library load/register/deregister proof is claimed.
YOLOv8n det/seg/pose use 1x3x640x640 profiles, cls uses 1x3x224x224, and OBB uses 1x3x1024x1024; these profiles remain build/report evidence until YoloVision real run logs validate.

--device runs build/load/runtime on a dedicated host thread and reads back the CUDA device. Real builds set/read back DLA/GPU fallback, tactic sources, DirectIO, and sparsity enable/disable; --stronglyTyped uses the TRT10 raw bit while TRT11 relies on its always-strongly-typed contract and TRT8 remains parse-only. DLA execution and model correctness remain host/model-specific proof.

features.feature: I/O format and layer precision policies
features.notes: Official I/O grammar, count/broadcast rules, exact-before-wildcard precedence, later-rule override, output broadcast, typed setters, and readback are implemented for TRT8/10. TRT11 can set allowed formats only when the inferred type matches; removed precision-constraint and layer setters remain guarded. This is builder evidence, not model accuracy or package-consumer proof.

Successful builds import --timingCacheFile/--timingCache and export --exportTimingCache through TensorRtTimingCache, recording byte counts and SHA256 in TimingCacheArtifact. Dry-run, load-engine, and dependency-unavailable paths keep the request as an explicit non-applied boundary; cache artifacts are not runtime proof.
Export-TensorRtExecGuiCliParityChecklist.ps1 records each trtexec-like option, CLI token, WinForms field, command preview path, status, next action, and non-proof boundary.
Requires continued option mapping, native API readiness, and smoke proof.
Needs public package, clean consumer, real model runtime, and post-publish proof.
